_comment: Overrides for the @ahl/certificates-react texts (packages/certificates-react/src/locales): this system's student and guardian wording. Every other key comes from the package.
subtitle: Issue, approve and send certificates to guardians, and manage their templates.

filters.search_placeholder: Student name or number, or certificate number

confirm.approve: Approve certificate {{no}} and send it to the guardian?

messages.sent: The certificate was sent to the guardian again.
messages.not_sent: WhatsApp delivery failed. Check the guardian's number or the messaging settings.

issue.recipients_hint: Search by name or number and add one or more students; each gets their own certificate.
issue.drafts_note: Certificates are created as drafts and reach guardians only after a supervisor approves them.
issue.direct_note: Certificates are approved on issue and sent to guardians.

templates.intro: Each certificate type has a bilingual template. The fields below can be used in the text and are replaced with the certificate's values on issue.
templates.show_photo: Show the student's photo on the certificate

verify.subtitle: Check a certificate issued by the Authority using the QR code printed on it.
verify.valid_body: This certificate was issued and approved by the Authority.
